title: Koala with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx="27" cy="32" r="14" fill="#8da2b5"/>
  <circle cx="73" cy="32" r="14" fill="#8da2b5"/>
  <circle cx="27" cy="32" r="9" fill="#d6a3c4"/>
  <circle cx="73" cy="32" r="9" fill="#d6a3c4"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="52" rx="30" ry="27" fill="#a9bccd"/>
  <!-- face patch -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="58" rx="20" ry="18" fill="#e3ecf2"/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="8" ry="6" fill="#6b4b6e"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="60.5" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#b48bb8"/>
  <!-- eyes: sparkly -->
  <circle cx="39" cy="48" r="7" fill="#1b1b3a"/>
  <circle cx="61" cy="48" r="7" fill="#1b1b3a"/>
  <circle cx="40.5" cy="46.5" r="2.6" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="62.5" cy="46.5" r="2.6" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="37.5" cy="50.5" r="1.3" fill="#bff7ff"/>
  <circle cx="59.5" cy="50.5" r="1.3" fill="#bff7ff"/>
  <!-- sparkle rays -->
  <rect x="37.5" y="41" width="1.5" height="5" rx="0.75" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <rect x="59.5" y="41" width="1.5" height="5" rx="0.75" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <rect x="34" y="44.2" width="5" height="1.5" rx="0.75" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <rect x="56" y="44.2" width="5" height="1.5" rx="0.75" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M44 68 Q50 73 56 68" stroke="#6b4b6e" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx="31" cy="60" r="3" fill="#f0a8c8" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="69" cy="60" r="3" fill="#f0a8c8" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- little body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="84" rx="18" ry="12" fill="#a9bccd"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="86" rx="11" ry="8" fill="#e3ecf2"/>
  <!-- paws -->
  <ellipse cx="39" cy="82" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#8da2b5"/>
  <ellipse cx="61" cy="82" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#8da2b5"/>
</svg>
